offering_description.value: Provides cable broadband, wireless, voice, video and data services in Alaska to consumers and businesses, plus network and managed IT services to government and health care customers, delivered over its own fiber, cable and satellite networks.

primary_products.value: mobile devices; set-top boxes; wireless routers

primary_services.value: wireless and wireline telephone; broadband internet; video; managed network services; cloud and data center services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Alaska households buying phone, internet and video plans; B2B: Alaska businesses, carriers and health care providers; B2G: State and federal agencies, school districts, and rural health networks

end_markets.value: telecommunications; health care; education; government; consumer

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly wireless, internet and video plans for consumers and businesses; product sales: mobile devices and equipment sold to customers; project or contract: network build-outs and managed services under government and health care contracts
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in network and service revenue, sells connectivity and IT services to end users; asset operator: owns and runs fiber, cable, wireless and satellite networks across Alaska

geography_served.value: US regional: Alaska statewide, including Anchorage, Fairbanks, Juneau and rural communities

specialization.value: related lines: wireless, wireline, cable broadband, video, and managed network and data services sharing one Alaska network

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company retail stores and customer service centers across Alaska; direct sales: enterprise and government account teams selling network services; online: web and app sales and account management for consumer plans; third-party retail: retail stores selling phones and devices
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; online; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licenses for wireless spectrum and Regulatory Commission of Alaska certification for telephone service

notes: GCI Liberty merged into Liberty Broadband in December 2020; this describes the Alaska operations as they were under GCI Liberty, and the current structure may differ.
divestiture_lines: P2.19: Liberty Broadband Corporation and GCI Liberty, Inc. completes the spin-off of GCI Liberty from Liberty Broadband.
